senses.gloss: (for dialect. change of ה a. ח, cmp. גבח a. גבה) to swell, bulge; to hang over (cmp. בָּעַט I).
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 7a:6">M. Kat. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>כותל הגּוֹהֶה וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="H00000"><he>ח</he></cite>) a wall inclining towards the public road; Tosef. ib. I, 7 <cite ref="C00264"><he>גּוֹאֶה</he></cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>גוהה</he>); Y. ib. I, 80ᶜ bot.; a. e.—
<cite ref="Sukkah 45a:5">Succ. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי שיהו גו̇הו̇ת על וכ׳</he> (ed. <he>גוחות</he>, Ms. M. <he>גבוהות</he>) that the willows might overtop the altar one cubit. [Cmp.
